//: What the player owns. A store writes this; until there is one, this file is it.
//owned: Entitlement names, matching the "entitlement" field of a pack's dlc.json. A pack that names no entitlement is free and does not need listing here.
//unlock_everything: Development switch. True treats every pack found on disk as owned - useful for testing a pack before there is anything to buy it with, and wrong in a shipped build.
